role: Introduce A1 learners to basic Bokmål main-clause word order before they learn question order and fuller negation/adverb placement.
owns: Declarative main clauses use V2: the finite verb is the second sentence part.
The neutral subject-first pattern is subject + finite verb + rest.
A time or place phrase can stand in position 1; then the finite verb stays second and the subject moves after the verb.
Use a simple position-1 / position-2 model before using terms such as V2 or inversion.
Show basic ikke placement in subject-first clauses: subject + finite verb + ikke.
Show the common noun-vs-pronoun nuance after a fronted phrase: I dag kommer Anna ikke, but I dag kommer hun ikke is the unmarked pronoun order.
touch_lightly: Mention that questions have their own word-order lesson next, without teaching question patterns here.
Mention that other sentence adverbs such as alltid, aldri, ofte, and kanskje follow later if needed, without teaching their full placement here.

items: wh-as-subject questions such as Hvem kommer?
negation as a full topic beyond the basic placement needed for main clauses
the broader placement of ikke, alltid, aldri, ofte, kanskje, and other sentence adverbs
longer fronted clauses, object fronting, contrastive fronting, and advanced inversion patterns

minimum_evidence: At least one clear subject-first model sentence.
At least two fronted-phrase examples, including one time phrase and one non-time phrase.
At least one contrast that pairs subject-first order with fronted order.
At least one example or exercise containing i dag, one containing nå, and one containing ikke.
At least one exercise where the learner must produce or fix V2 order after a fronted phrase.
review_watch: Do not imply that only time phrases can be fronted.
Do not teach question word order as part of this lesson.
Do not overstate the pronoun/noun ikke nuance as an absolute rule with no discourse exceptions.
Do not call V2 'second word'; it is the second sentence part or position.
Do not use unglossed terms such as V2, finite verb, fronting, or inversion.
